title: Is Elon Musk's AI Encyclopedia Grokipedia Stuck? It Is Suspected to Be Unmaintained After Months of Launch

content_html: AI-generated encyclopedia, Grokipedia, which was once highly anticipated by Elon Musk and he claimed would greatly improve Wikipedia, has recently fallen into a long period of silence. According to a recent report by the foreign media Lawfare, the platform has not made any noticeable updates since April 24. Looking back at its development history, Grokipedia was officially launched in October 2025 with version 0.1, initially containing about 885,000 articles. The platform then upgraded to version 0.2, quickly surpassing 6 million articles in total. However, despite the large number of articles displayed on the official real-time status page, the "Recent Updates" section, which was originally used to track the latest changes, currently shows "No current real-time edits available." Moreover, although ordinary users can still submit article suggestions or modification requests, surveys show that a large number of modification requests have not been marked as "Accepted" or "Rejected" in the past three months, revealing delays in user interaction and review mechanisms. This has directly led to speculation on communities and social platforms about whether the project has already "stopped operating." It is worth noting that the last time Elon Musk mentioned Grokipedia on a public social media platform was in February this year. With the decrease in public discussions and the stagnation of updates, the future of this ambitious AI encyclopedia project remains under continuous attention from the industry.

content_html_zh: 曾经被埃隆·马斯克寄予厚望、声称将极大改善维基百科的人工智能生成百科全书 Grokipedia 最近陷入了长时间的沉寂。 据外媒Lawfare近日报道，自4月24日以来，该平台尚未做出任何明显的更新。 回顾其发展历史，Grokipedia 于 2025 年 10 月正式上线，版本为 0.1，最初包含约 885,000 篇文章。 随后平台升级至0.2版本，文章总数迅速突破600万篇。 然而，尽管官方实时状态页面上显示了大量文章，但原本用于追踪最新变化的“最近更新”部分，目前却显示“当前没有可用的实时编辑”。 此外，虽然普通用户仍然可以提交文章建议或修改请求，但调查显示，过去三个月内大量修改请求没有被标记为“已接受”或“已拒绝”，揭示了用户交互和审核机制的延迟。 这直接引发了社区和社交平台上关于该项目是否已经“停止运营”的猜测。 值得注意的是，埃隆·马斯克最后一次在公共社交媒体平台上提及 Grokipedia 是在今年 2 月。 随着公众讨论的减少和更新的停滞，这个雄心勃勃的人工智能百科全书项目的未来仍然受到业界的持续关注。
